backward_compat_traps.rule: IO-Link is point-to-point single-drop (one Device per Master port), NOT a fieldbus and NOT a multi-drop bus.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating IO-Link as a bus with multiple addressed Devices on one wire is wrong.

backward_compat_traps.rule: The C/Q line is binary switching in SIO mode and UART communication in SDCI mode.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Assuming the C/Q line is always a UART line ignores the SIO switching behavior before wake-up.

backward_compat_traps.rule: The Master issues the wake-up request and every M-sequence; the Device only answers.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Expecting the Device to initiate communication is wrong.

fields.spec_version: IEC 61131-9 (SDCI — Single-drop Digital Communication Interface) / IO-Link

lineage.summary: Original IBM PC serial-port UART; no FIFOs.
Faster INS8250; no FIFOs; widely used in IBM PC/AT.
First version with 16-byte FIFOs; had RX FIFO bug.
FIFO bug fixed; widely deployed in 286/386 era.
Current National Semiconductor part; M2CMOS process; 24 MHz max XIN.

fields.version_naming_history_note: IO-Link is standardized internationally by the IEC as IEC 61131-9 under the name SDCI (Single-drop Digital Communication Interface). The interface preserves the C/Q combined communication and switching line, the SIO/SDCI dual mode with a wake-up request, UART 8-E-1 framing at COM1/COM2/COM3, M-sequences with CKT/CKS checksums, cyclic Process Data, acyclic On-request Data via the ISDU (Index/Subindex), Events, and the IODD across revisions; v1.1 added larger Process Data, Data Storage, and COM3.
previous_versions: IO-Link Interface Spec v1.0 (2009) — first SDCI single-drop link.
IO-Link Interface Spec v1.1 (2011) — larger Process Data, Data Storage, COM3 (230.4 kbaud).

key_changes.summary: Added larger Process Data, the Data Storage mechanism (Master-side parameter backup/restore for Device replacement), additional M-sequence types, and COM3 (230.4 kbaud).

Standardized the IO-Link interface internationally as SDCI (Single-drop Digital Communication Interface), aligning the C/Q line, SIO/SDCI modes, wake-up, UART 8-E-1 framing, M-sequences, ISDU, Events, and IODD.

future_versions_industry_outline.summary: Continued refinement of Process Data, Data Storage, and security profiles (IO-Link Safety, IO-Link Wireless) while preserving the SDCI C/Q single-drop point-to-point link, UART framing, M-sequences, ISDU, and IODD.
